cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The baker said dense with such confidence that I've written it on your cake label. It sounds distinguished, love.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant hard to eat. I thought I might finally be good at baking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dense, substantial—people want a cake that lasts. Put it on your best stand; let's show it properly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then I'll give him a slice and ask him to explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me take it over. I'll use his word, substantial, and tell him how much work you put in before he says anything else.

reason: Create specific misunderstood language or copied behavior, then make the subsequent Drive tactics respond to B rather than merely add confident phrases.
